title: applyAstGrep overwrite discards the user's existing sgconfig.yml
reason: By design: overwrite-after-confirm is the documented init contract (confirmOverwrite prompt defaults to no, i18n.ts:42; README -y overwrites without prompting); eslint/editorconfig appliers replace existing files the same way

title: Avoid destructive sgconfig.yml overwrite under --yes
reason: By design: README.md:182 and i18n.ts:64 document --yes as overwrite without prompting; applyAstGrep shares the confirmOverwrite gate (default No) with the eslint/editorconfig/prettier appliers

title: Remove no-op sourceSets filter in jvmHelpers
reason: Pure style: filter never removes an entry (sourceRoots[0] is src/main/<lang>), no observable behavioral effect

title: Resolve children of path-attributed Rust modules by their file stem
reason: Refuted by rustc: with #[path="renamed.rs"] mod renamed; a child mod child; in renamed.rs resolves to sibling src/child.rs (E0583 asks for child.rs or child/mod.rs when missing), so modRs for path-attributed decls is correct
